func work(_ item: Int) async {}

final class Runner {
  var items: [Int] = []
  var tasks: [Task<Void, Never>] = []

  // CASE let_one_apostrophe expect=pass
  func start() {
    for item in items {
      let task = Task<Void, Never> {
        // Don't block the caller.
        await work(item)
      }
      tasks.append(task)
    }
  }
}
